name: QRdx
description: Connects to the hosted QRdx MCP endpoint to design QR codes with a scan score (SVG, PNG and a playground link), build Wi-Fi, contact, email, SMS, location and bank-payment payloads, and check and render barcodes (EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 128, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec and more). These tools need no key. Saving themes and barcodes to a QRdx workspace needs a QRdx API key sent as a Bearer header, which this entry does not configure.
